senses.gloss:
मिद् 1. मिद्, cl. 1. P. A. मेदति, -ते, &c.,
= rt. मिथ्, q. v.

मिद् 2. मिद् or मिन्द्, cl. 1. A. मेदते,
मिमिदे, मेदिष्यति, अमिदत्, मेदितुम्;
cl. 4. P. A. मेद्यति, -ते, मिमेद, मिमिदे, मेदिष्-
यति, अमिदत्, मेदितुम्; cl. 10. P. मिन्दयति,
मेदयति, &c., to become fat; to be unctuous or
[]
greasy; to liquefy, melt; to feel affection for any one,
love [cf. मित्र, rt. स्निह्]; to rejoice (Ved. ?); Caus.
मेदयति, -यितुम्, to fatten, make fat (Ved.); [cf.
Gr. μειδάω: Old Germ. minna, minni, ‘love:’
Lith. myliu, ‘I love;’ miêlas, ‘dear:’ Russ. milyĭ,
‘kind, affable.’]
